answer: A new identity serves a probation of 4 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the nebula queue naming the juniper that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, every sock puppet costs 4 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the opal record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
